scene.topic_description:
Situation: Later in the same interview, the conversation turns to pay and conditions. The learner is especially worried about salary questions, so this is the core scene where compensation is clarified and expectations are discussed.
Learner: Candidate. Partner: Interviewer.
Not in this scene: introductions, work history, daily duties, detailed next steps after the interview.
must_say: ask what salary range is offered — slot: the position
ask whether the salary is gross or net — slot: the salary figure
ask how often salary is paid — slot: the pay period
ask whether there are bonuses or benefits — slot: the benefit
explain your salary expectation — slot: the amount or range
ask whether the amount is negotiable — slot: the amount
confirm what is included in the offer — slot: the item included
must_understand: says the salary range for the role
explains whether the amount is gross or net
tells how often employees are paid
offers information about bonuses or benefits
asks what salary you are expecting

topic.description_target: Ask about the salary, clarify gross or net pay, discuss benefits, and state your expectations.
topic.description_native: Chiedere informazioni sullo stipendio, chiarire se è lordo o netto, discutere i benefit ed esprimere le proprie aspettative.

phrases.frame_target: What salary range is offered for ___?
phrases.pronunciation_native: uòt sàlari rèindj iz òferd for ___?

fillers.pronunciation_native: abàut tu tàusend èit handred iùrou
tu tàusend sèven handred tu thrì tàusend iùrou

partner_lines.text_target: The salary range for this role is €2,500 to €3,000 per month.
partner_lines.text_native: La fascia salariale per questo ruolo va da 2.500 a 3.000 euro al mese.

partner_lines.text_target: The quoted amount is gross, before taxes.
partner_lines.text_native: L'importo indicato è lordo, prima delle tasse.

partner_lines.text_target: Employees are paid once a month.
partner_lines.text_native: I dipendenti vengono pagati una volta al mese.

partner_lines.text_target: Yes. The package includes additional pay after the trial period.
partner_lines.text_native: Sì. Il pacchetto prevede una maggiorazione dopo il periodo di prova.

vocabulary.image_prompt: A printed employment benefits package on a desk

vocabulary.definition_target: a short time when a new employee is evaluated
vocabulary.image_prompt: A calendar marking the beginning of a new employee's trial period

partner_lines.text_target: The salary range for this role is between thirty-five and forty thousand euros per year.
partner_lines.text_native: La fascia di stipendio per questo ruolo va da trentacinquemila a quarantamila euro lordi all'anno.

partner_lines.text_native: La cifra è lorda, prima delle tasse e dei contributi previdenziali.

partner_lines.text_native: I dipendenti vengono pagati ogni mese, nell'ultimo giorno lavorativo.

partner_lines.text_target: Yes. A performance bonus is available after the probation period.
partner_lines.text_native: Sì. È previsto un bonus legato ai risultati dopo il periodo di prova.
